verdict.rationale: Intel's Gaudi docs cover running PyTorch training and inference through an official Gaudi Docker image. They also cover DeepSpeed, distributed training, vLLM and SGLang, which is direct first-party support for mainstream PyTorch-based frameworks. No support matrix or version compatibility table appears in the evidence, and frameworks beyond the PyTorch ecosystem are not shown. Missing for 10: an explicit published support matrix (framework/driver/version compatibility), evidence for non-PyTorch frameworks such as TensorFlow or JAX, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, PyTorch and mainstream ML frameworks run on this GPU through officially documented builds and support matrices
